title: Discrete integration of the isoperimetric difference inequality
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, K ∈ ℝ with K > 0, ρ₁ ∈ ℝ and V : ℝ → ℝ. Assume (i) V(r) > 0 for every r with 0 < r < ρ₁, and (ii) V(ρ)^{m/(m+1)} ≤ (K/δ)·(V(ρ+δ) − V(ρ)) for all ρ > 0, δ > 0 with ρ + δ < ρ₁, where x^{m/(m+1)} is the real power (Real.rpow). Then (ρ/(2K(m+1)))^{m+1} ≤ V(ρ) (natural power m+1) for every ρ with 0 < ρ < ρ₁.
